decisions.decision:
Start now on the T-454 skeleton. Don't wait for T-455/456/457. The packager re-runs as they land.
1) Write app/scripts/build-revops-os.mjs. It reads revops-os/ (reuse build.py/build-kits.sh output if it already assembles kits) and makes (a) tantra-revops-os.zip and (b) a chat edition of a few bundled files sized for Claude/ChatGPT project uploads. Add a VERSION stamp (git sha + date) to both.
2) Copy both into the centre's static output (cloud/public/os/) through cloud/scripts/build.sh. Serve /os/tantra-revops-os.zip and /os/tantra-revops-os-chat.zip with the right Content-Type and Content-Disposition.
3) Prove it on local :8790, then deploy the review build. curl both URLs, unzip them, check the version and the file list. Paste the evidence on the task.
4) Commit to the tantra-redesign repo only, then move the task to review. Day 0 card wiring stays in T-459.
decisions.why: The plan's T-458 row (REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md, line 67) spells out the build and route. revops-os/ already exists. Deploying our own Worker is approved under orchestrator-autonomy. Packaging can be rebuilt as the content tasks land.
